notes.title: Neon Runner Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
About the Demo:

[list]
[*] 4 Procedurally Generated Levels: Each level offers a unique experience with increasing difficulty as you progress
[*] Dynamic Obstacles: Navigate through a variety of challenging obstacles
[*] High scores: Create a highscore
[*] Share your feedback and scores!
[/list]

Try out Neon Runner and experience its high-speed gameplay. Your feedback is appreciated.
